about: anthropic's decision table (the P3 procedure). The Messages API's turns, each the World's scenario's when it scripts one, else the labeled stub (THE TWIN RUNS NO MODEL), with the answer, the stream, prompt-cache reads and writes and usage in the vendor's shapes; Claude Code's token counts; the Models API's catalog; and the Console's sign-up, login mail and API keys as doors and screens. Every operation no in-scope application calls answers the vendor's gap; the non-beta token count, which no application calls, is unmodeled.

decisions.demand: Dub's, Twenty's and LibreChat's turns (streamed and not, tools, thinking, prompt caching, images, structured output)
decisions.why: an action: the request checked as the API checks it, the turn the scenario's or the stub, the prompt cache read and written with its lifetime, the answer or its stream with usage

decisions.demand: Claude Code's turns under Volter Harness (POST /v1/messages?beta=true, measured)
decisions.why: the same action as messages_post, sent through the SDK's beta namespace

decisions.demand: Claude Code's token counts under Volter Harness
decisions.why: a computation: the request checked and its input tokens counted; no message is made and nothing is cached

a lookup of the vendor's catalog (the models an organization can use, newest first, with their limits and capabilities), paged by before_id and after_id; the API offers no write to store models through

decisions.demand: the admin who makes every application's key
decisions.why: a person signs up on the Console, which makes their organization and its Default workspace; the API has no sign-up
the Console emails a login code; the World's mailbox is where it is read
an API key is made on the Console's API keys page; the Admin API cannot create one

decisions.demand: the key the World's application holds at boot (the descriptor's credentialDoor)
decisions.why: the runtime issues the application's key as the Console would make it
